pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex, non-polygonal geometry characterized by jagged, stellate perimeters and high-contrast pixel gradients at boundaries. Individual regions exhibit significant multi-lobed 'leaf-like' structures with sharp angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Dendritic negative-space network with thin, non-uniform pixel thickness. Topological junctions are frequent and irregular, forming a high-density web of interconnected light-colored pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff mane texture visible along the cranial neck segment, presenting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched on the subject: one on the upper neck ridge, one on the mid-dorsal ridge, one on the posterior ridge, and two on the mid-lateral flank.
